name: mirage
text: BoltOdds: the plan allows 3 connections and the GitHub runner holds 2, so any socket the phone opened on top (a phone scan, the streaming engine or the live tennis lane could still open one) got refused. Fixed: while GitHub holds the sockets the phone now can't open a BoltOdds socket at all (it reads the REST snapshot if it ever needs to). Ships in the next release.
